anchors.basis: Valve's official 2026-10-05 global standings contain two rows labelled 'benched gods': #157 (facer, K014NZ, norescue, Wign, yoyoS2) and #329 (BloodyK, f1chper, K014NZ, MisterHy, Wign). The anchor lineup shares 5 players with #157 and 2 with #329, so exactly one row satisfies Valve's own >=3 rule and scripts.vrs.identify can act once a lineup is supplied. No probability is derived from this anchor; it only unblocks the documented pick-only tier for Hotspawn fixture 1081597, whose opponent TitanFlow is absent from the standings.
